## DQ Rule Review Checklist

### A. Validity (Precision)
- [ ] Valid (합리적, 바로 적용 가능)
- [ ] Valid but minor edit 필요
- [ ] Not valid (도메인/불일치)

### B. Relevance (Proxy Recall)
- [ ] Relevant
- [ ] Partially Relevant
- [ ] Not Relevant

### C. Friction (effort)
- [ ] Low Effort
- [ ] Minor Edit 
- [ ] Major Edit
- [ ] Extra Work Needed
